decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the established radiant-heater business in a growing firm, it is likely to be retained, though its lower public visibility on the website makes withdrawal somewhat easier than for more prominently launched products.

The firm has publicly backed this electric infrared panel heater with a dedicated page and it fits the broader move toward integrated and lower-carbon heating solutions, which supports continued commitment.

Although the product received a dedicated presentation and benefits from the firm's tendency to persist with recent launches, this halogen variant appears somewhat more niche and less central to the announced strategic direction than other offerings.
This industrial electric infrared hall heater is close to the core offer, was given its own product page, and suits the firm's industrial customer base, making continued support very likely.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is closely tied to the firm's stated future direction and was publicly highlighted with a named launch and real operating installation, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
